card.text: Explore Feronia in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Nonconvex model constrained by resolved imaging. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Nonconvex model constrained by resolved imaging, 93 ± 10 km volume-equivalent diameter in the selected archive record. Grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 46.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
